STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: SIC2 Console
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Top-mounted console with ANT+ power display. Secured by 3mm hex screws via the power wire channel.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: SPM2 Power Meter
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Crank-arm power meter. ANT+ 5-digit ID. Battery spacer or taped AA batteries. Zero reset ADC must read 790–990.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: FitLoc Lever & Handlebar Stem
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Quick-release lever for handlebar height adjustment. Insert handlebar post, push lever down to lock.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: Fore/Aft Slide Knob
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Adjusts horizontal saddle position along the rail.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: Resistance / Brake Knob
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Controls magnetic eddy-current braking force. Press down for emergency stop.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: SprintShift Lever
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Multi-stage quick shift for instant resistance jumps during sprints.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: Flywheel
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Perimeter-weighted aluminum flywheel with magnetic eddy-current brake.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: Pedal CR-L (Left)
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Left pedal — REVERSE THREADED. Turn CLOCKWISE to remove, counterclockwise to install.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: Pedal CR-R (Right)
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Right pedal — standard thread. Turn counterclockwise to remove, clockwise to install.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: Saddle Height Clamp
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Clamp securing the seatpost at the desired height.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: Stabilizers (Front/Rear)
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Front: wheels facing forward. Rear: step plates with sloped edge pointing away. M10 bolts. 4 leveling feet with 14mm nut.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: Belt Drive
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Poly-V belt connecting pedal crank to flywheel. Vibration or slipping requires technician service.

STAGES_SC3_PARTS.name: Crank Arm
STAGES_SC3_PARTS.description: Connects pedals to the flywheel via the bottom bracket. SPM2 power meter is integrated here.

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: Brake pad or flywheel housing misalignment. Possible loose flywheel bolt.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: Immediately take bike out of rotation. Do NOT ride. Schedule technician inspection.

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: FitLoc cam mechanism worn or post not inserted deep enough.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: Check post insertion depth (min line visible). If still slipping, tag bike for FitLoc replacement.

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.symptom: Power meter not pairing / no watts displayed
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: ANT+ pairing failure or dead batteries in SPM2.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: 1. Check/replace AA batteries (use spacer or tape). 2. Re-pair using 5-digit ANT+ ID on console. 3. If still dead, check power wire channel connection.

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: SPM2 zero offset out of range. May indicate mechanical stress on crank arm.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: Re-attempt zero reset with NO weight on pedals. If ADC reads outside 790–990 after 3 attempts, remove and reseat crank arm at 52–57 N·m. Escalate to Stages support if persistent.

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: Pedal has unscrewed from the crank arm — most often the left (CR-L) pedal, which is REVERSE threaded and works loose if it was never torqued to spec.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: Take the bike out of rotation immediately — a pedal that can detach is a rider-safety fault. Refit at 42 N·m with a 15mm pedal wrench (left pedal: turn CLOCKWISE to tighten). Inspect the crank-arm threads; if they are stripped, replace the crank arm (8mm hex, 52–57 N·m).

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: Pedal threads stripped or cross-threaded. Remember: left pedal is REVERSE threaded.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: Do NOT force. Remove pedal, inspect threads. If crank arm threads are stripped, replace crank arm (8mm hex, 52–57 N·m). Apply grease to threads before reinstall.

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: Power wire disconnected or console battery dead.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: 1. Check power wire in channel under handlebar. 2. Replace console batteries. 3. Reseat 3mm hex screws. If still dead, replace SIC2 console unit.

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: Belt tension loss or misalignment. Normal wear after heavy usage.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: Take bike out of rotation. Belt tensioning requires trained technician. Do not attempt field adjustment.

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.symptom: Resistance knob not engaging / no resistance change
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: Magnetic brake pad gap too wide or brake knob cable disconnected.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: Check brake knob cable routing under shroud. If cable intact, brake pad gap needs technician adjustment.

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: Stabilizer feet not leveled or stabilizer bolts loose.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: Adjust 4 leveling feet (14mm nut) until all contact the floor evenly. Tighten M10 stabilizer bolts (6mm hex + 17mm wrench).

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: Saddle clamp not tightened or clamp mechanism worn.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: Tighten saddle clamp with 13mm wrench. If clamp is worn/stripped, replace the clamp assembly.

STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.diagnosis: SprintShift cable binding or lever mechanism jammed.
STAGES_SC3_TROUBLESHOOTING.action: Check cable routing. If lever mechanism is jammed, take bike out of rotation for technician service.
